name: mac-wf
prompt:
kk-engine (C++20, Vulkan through volk, CMake + Ninja) gets a macOS CI job: soucouyant cross-compiles an x86_64 macOS package on Linux with osxcross (clang 18, macOS SDK 26.1, image docker/macos.Dockerfile), and a 2018 Intel MacBook Air (macOS 14, MoltenVK, Forgejo runner label macos-amd64, host mode, started on demand) only unpacks that package and runs the unit tests. Write the new Forgejo workflow .forgejo/workflows/macos.yml (Forgejo Actions, GitHub Actions syntax). Copy the layout of .forgejo/workflows/windows-native.yml (given), with these differences:
1. Header comment: macOS (Intel) tests on the Mac runner (label macos-amd64: a 2018 MacBook Air, macOS 14, MoltenVK); soucouyant cross-builds the x86_64 package with osxcross (docker/macos.Dockerfile) and the Mac only unpacks it and runs the unit tests with tools/ci/macos_test.sh, nothing is built there; the Mac's runner is started on demand, so this runs only by hand (no schedule), and a dispatch waits in the queue while the Mac is off.
2. `name: macOS`. `on:` has only `workflow_dispatch:` (no inputs, no schedule). `concurrency:` group `macos`, cancel-in-progress false. `env:` KKE_JOBS "8" and VERSION macos-test.
3. Job `build`: runs-on soucouyant, timeout-minutes 120, container image `git.kreative-kompas.com/khyretos/kke-macos:1`. Steps:
   a. actions/checkout@v4.
   b. `Source tree at /tmp/kke-src`: a comment (the tests read the source tree at the path they were built from, KKE_SOURCE_DIR; /tmp/kke-src exists on the Mac too, where macos_test.sh unpacks the same tree), then run: `git archive --format=tar HEAD > src.tar`, `mkdir -p /tmp/kke-src`, `tar -xf src.tar -C /tmp/kke-src`.
   c. `Configure (osxcross, x86_64)` with `working-directory: /tmp/kke-src`: the windows-native configure with `-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/toolchains/macos-x86_64-osxcross.cmake` instead of the MinGW one (keep set -o pipefail, -DKKE_ENABLE_FEMFX=ON, -DKKE_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON, -DKKE_ENABLE_VALIDATION=OFF, "-DKKE_VERSION_NAME=$VERSION", | tee configure.log).
   d. `Build`, `No warnings anywhere`: as in windows-native, each with `working-directory: /tmp/kke-src`.
   e. `Package` with `working-directory: /tmp/kke-src`, run: `tools/packaging/package.sh --bin build/bin --platform macos --version "$VERSION" --out "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist" --deps build/_deps` (no --strip), then `cp build/bin/kke_tests "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist/"` and `cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src.tar" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist/"`.
   f. `https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/upload-artifact@v4` with name macos-build, path dist/.
4. Job `test`: needs build, runs-on macos-amd64, timeout-minutes 60, no container, no defaults (the default bash shell). Steps: actions/checkout@v4; `https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/download-artifact@v4` with name macos-build, path dist; `Unit tests` running `tools/ci/macos_test.sh "dist/kk-engine-$VERSION-macos-x86_64.tar.gz" dist/kke_tests dist/src.tar kke-run results`; then `https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/upload-artifact@v4` with `if: always()`, name macos-tests, path results/.
